features.name: Dependency graph and query Skill installation
features.summary: Installs two independent, bundled project Skills: graph generation and read-only graph querying, with explicit update confirmation and different packaging requirements.

features.name: Human entity descriptions and restoring Agent prose
features.summary: Edits human-owned entity descriptions independently of generated graph structure and restores the newest generated prose by removing the override.

features.name: Graph refresh and freshness boundaries
features.summary: Reloads generated Knowledge Graph data for editor surfaces and separately maintains an existing deterministic structural graph after source changes.

features.name: Isolated MCP installation and client configuration
features.summary: Installs a bundled MCP runtime in extension storage, gates publication on dependency audit and health checks, and updates only the selected project's VibeKnowledge MCP configuration entry.
